interface.name: halley_surface_dismissal_manager_v1

description.summary: opt-in outside-click notifications for layer surfaces

interface.description: Applications may watch one of their own layer-shell surfaces for an outside left-button press. This is not a global input monitor: no pointer coordinates, target identities, or unrelated input events are exposed. Binding this optional global does not change focus or input routing.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: surface must have a layer-shell role

request.name: watch
request.description: The surface must already have a layer-shell role. Each watch is one-shot and takes effect immediately. Notifications are sent only while the surface is buffer-mapped. Destroying the watch cancels it. Unmapping or destroying the surface cancels the watch permanently; remapping requires a new watch. A client can only reference surfaces on its own connection.

interface.name: halley_surface_dismissal_v1
interface.description: The application decides whether and how to dismiss its UI. The compositor does not close the surface or consume the outside click. This interface does not grant input grabs or permission to observe another client.

event.name: outside_press

description.summary: a left press occurred outside the mapped surface

event.description: Sent at most once per watch. Input continues to the ordinary target. Clicks on this surface or its popups are considered inside. The client should destroy this watch after receiving the event.
